The '''DLC-13 Mining Droid''' was a model of [[Mining droid/Legends|mining droid]] used on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] by the [[Klegger Corporation]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="RotS" /> and later by the [[Mensix Mining Company]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:ToOW" /> This droid was made of heat-resistant [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] and was equipped with low-powered [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generators]].<ref name="SWGTCG" />
{{Droid-stub}}
